recordSet.description: Station metadata from Ireland's Office of Public Works (OPW) Hydro-Data registry (https://waterlevel.ie/hydro-data/data/internet/stations/stations.json): station name (`station_name`), waterbody (`WTO_OBJECT`), and catchment size (`CATCHMENT_SIZE` in inline km2 units). Elevation is withheld (`station_elevation` is blank across river stations and `station_gauge_datum` is staff-gauge datum height above Ordnance Datum). Contains Irish Public Sector Information licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence (source http://waterlevel.ie/hydro-data/ - provided by the Office of Public Works.).
